text.traditional: 暑假快到了，你有什麼打算？最近我和幾個朋友計畫去環島旅行，想跟我們去嗎？
text.simplified: 暑假快到了，你有什么打算？最近我和几个朋友计划去环岛旅行，想跟我们去吗？
text.pinyin: Shǔjià kuài dào le, nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuàn? Zuìjìn wǒ hé jǐ ge péngyǒu jìhuà qù huándǎo lǚxíng, xiǎng gēn wǒmen qù ma?
text.english: Summer vacation is almost here. What are your plans? Recently a few friends and I are planning a trip around the island; want to come with us?

text.traditional: 想倒是想，可是我要趁暑假多打一點兒工，多存一些錢。因為畢業後，我打算去法國留學。
text.simplified: 想倒是想，可是我要趁暑假多打一点儿工，多存一些钱。因为毕业后，我打算去法国留学。
text.pinyin: Xiǎng dàoshì xiǎng, kěshì wǒ yào chèn shǔjià duō dǎ yìdiǎnr gōng, duō cún yìxiē qián. Yīnwèi bìyè hòu, wǒ dǎsuàn qù Fǎguó liúxué.
text.english: I do want to, but I need to take advantage of summer break to work a bit more and save more money. Because after graduation, I plan to study abroad in France.

text.traditional: 你平常下課後就去補習，暑假還要打工，有休閒活動的時間嗎？
text.simplified: 你平常下课后就去补习，暑假还要打工，有休闲活动的时间吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ píngcháng xiàkè hòu jiù qù bǔxí, shǔjià háiyào dǎgōng, yǒu xiūxián huódòng de shíjiān ma?
text.english: You usually go to tutoring after class, and you have to work part-time in the summer; do you have time for leisure activities?

text.traditional: 我有空的時候還是會上網看看電影、玩玩遊戲什麼的。
text.simplified: 我有空的时候还是会上网看看电影、玩玩游戏什么的。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǒukòng de shíhòu háishì huì shàngwǎng kànkan diànyǐng, wán wán yóuxì shénme de.
text.english: When I'm free, I still go online to watch movies, play games, and stuff.

text.traditional: 你不想去戶外走走嗎？最近有人調查臺灣青少年的休閒活動，發現其中有五分之四的人最常去的休閒場所是「家裡」。最讓我驚訝的是，這五分之四裡面有一半的人，週末都在家上網或睡覺。
text.simplified: 你不想去户外走走吗？最近有人调查台湾青少年的休闲活动，发现其中有五分之四的人最常去的休闲场所是「家里」。最让我惊讶的是，这五分之四里面有一半的人，周末都在家上网或睡觉。
text.pinyin: Nǐ bù xiǎng qù hùwài zǒuzǒu ma? Zuìjìn yǒurén diàochá Táiwān qīngshàonián de xiūxián huódòng, fāxiàn qízhōng yǒu wǔ fēn zhī sì de rén zuì cháng qù de xiūxián chǎngsuǒ shì “jiālǐ”. Zuì ràng wǒ jīngyà de shì, zhè wǔ fēn zhī sì lǐmiàn yǒu yíbàn de rén, zhōumò dōu zài jiā shàngwǎng huò shuìjiào.
text.english: Don't you want to go outdoors? Recently someone surveyed leisure activities of Taiwanese youth and found that for 4/5 of them, the most frequented leisure venue is 'home'. What surprised me most is that half of that 4/5 spend weekends online or sleeping at home.

text.traditional: 哈哈哈！我就是其中一個。其實，我不但喜歡戶外活動，以前還常跟哥哥去日本滑雪，做一些刺激的活動。我知道運動對身心健康很有幫助，只是最近又打工又補習，回到家就累得不想動了。
text.simplified: 哈哈哈！我就是其中一个。其实，我不但喜欢户外活动，以前还常跟哥哥去日本滑雪，做一些刺激的活动。我知道运动对身心健康很有帮助，只是最近又打工又补习，回到家就累得不想动了。
text.pinyin: Hāhāhā! Wǒ jiùshì qízhōng yíge. Qíshí, wǒ búdàn xǐhuān hùwài huódòng, yǐqián hái cháng gēn gēge qù Rìběn huáxuě, zuò yìxiē cìjī de huódòng. Wǒ zhīdào yùndòng duì shēnxīn jiànkāng hěn yǒu bāngzhù, zhǐshì zuìjìn yòu dǎgōng yòu bǔxí, huí dào jiā jiù lèi de bù xiǎng dòng le.
text.english: Hahaha! I'm one of them. Actually, not only do I like outdoor activities, I used to often go skiing in Japan with my older brother and do thrilling activities. I know exercise helps physical and mental health; it's just that lately with both part-time work and tutoring, I'm too tired to move once I get home.

text.traditional: 這樣你的體力會越來越差的，應該多出去流流汗才好。下個週末有一場海灘球賽，我們還少一位球員。你有興趣嘗試嗎？
text.simplified: 这样你的体力会越来越差的，应该多出去流流汗才好。下个周末有一场海滩球赛，我们还少一位球员。你有兴趣尝试吗？
text.pinyin: Zhèyàng nǐ de tǐlì huì yuè lái yuè chà de, yīnggāi duō chūqù liú liúhàn cái hǎo. Xià ge zhōumò yǒu yì chǎng hǎitān qiúsài, wǒmen hái shǎo yí wèi qiúyuán. Nǐ yǒu xìngqù chángshì ma?
text.english: Your physical stamina will get worse and worse this way; it's better to get out and sweat. Next weekend there is a beach ball game, and we're short one player. Interested in trying?

text.traditional: 我不去！我怕水，對大海也有心理障礙。
text.simplified: 我不去！我怕水，对大海也有心理障碍。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bú qù! Wǒ pà shuǐ, duì dàhǎi yě yǒu xīnlǐ zhàng'ài.
text.english: I'm not going! I'm afraid of water and I also have a psychological barrier toward the sea.

text.traditional: 你不想克服這個障礙嗎？
text.simplified: 你不想克服这个障碍吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ bù xiǎng kèfú zhège zhàng'ài ma?
text.english: Don't you want to overcome this barrier?

text.traditional: 當然想。上個星期我跟一位會衝浪的朋友見面，看他自由自在衝浪的樣子，好酷喔！真希望這輩子也能學會衝浪。
text.simplified: 当然想。上个星期我跟一位会冲浪的朋友见面，看他自由自在冲浪的样子，好酷喔！真希望这辈子也能学会冲浪。
text.pinyin: Dāngrán xiǎng. Shàng ge xīngqí wǒ gēn yí wèi huì chōnglàng de péngyǒu jiànmiàn, kàn tā zìyóuzìzài chōnglàng de yàngzi, hǎo kù o! Zhēn xīwàng zhè bèizi yě néng xuéhuì chōnglàng.
text.english: Of course I do. Last week I met a friend who surfs; watching him surf freely and easily was so cool! I really hope I can learn to surf in this lifetime.

text.traditional: 這樣好了，等你去了法國，我請我叔叔教你。他是個衝浪教練，我從小就跟著他學。記得有一次練習時，牙齒被衝浪板打到了，流了很多血，有一段時間不敢衝浪。還好，最後總算克服了。
text.simplified: 这样好了，等你去了法国，我请我叔叔教你。他是个冲浪教练，我从小就跟着他学。记得有一次练习时，牙齿被冲浪板打到了，流了很多血，有一段时间不敢冲浪。还好，最后总算克服了。
text.pinyin: Zhèyàng hǎo le, děng nǐ qù le Fǎguó, wǒ qǐng wǒ shúshu jiāo nǐ. Tā shì ge chōnglàng jiàoliàn, wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù gēnzhe tā xué. Jìde yǒu yí cì liànxí shí, yáchǐ bèi chōnglàngbǎn dǎ dào le, liú le hěn duō xiě, yǒu yí duàn shíjiān bù gǎn chōnglàng. Háihǎo, zuìhòu zǒngsuàn kèfú le.
text.english: How about this: once you go to France, I'll ask my uncle to teach you. He's a surf coach; I've learned from him since I was little. I remember once during practice the surfboard hit my teeth and I bled a lot, and for a while I didn't dare to surf. Fortunately, I finally overcame it.

text.traditional: 既然你這樣說，下個週末我就跟你去參加海灘球賽吧。
text.simplified: 既然你这样说，下个周末我就跟你去参加海滩球赛吧。
text.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ zhèyàng shuō, xià ge zhōumò wǒ jiù gēn nǐ qù cānjiā hǎitān qiúsài ba.
text.english: Since you put it that way, next weekend I'll go with you to join the beach ball game.

text.traditional: 太好了。不過，參加球賽是需要體力的，你最好主動一點兒，每天去慢跑。要是比賽贏了，我就招待你去吃大餐。
text.simplified: 太好了。不过，参加球赛是需要体力的，你最好主动一点儿，每天去慢跑。要是比赛赢了，我就招待你去吃大餐。
text.pinyin: Tài hǎo le. Búguò, cānjiā qiúsài shì xūyào tǐlì de, nǐ zuìhǎo zhǔdòng yìdiǎnr, měitiān qù mànpǎo. Yàoshì bǐsài yíng le, wǒ jiù zhāodài nǐ qù chī dà cān.
text.english: Awesome. However, playing in the game takes stamina; you'd better be proactive and jog every day. If we win the game, I'll treat you to a feast.

text.traditional: 太棒了！我今天就開始去跑步，練練體力。
text.simplified: 太棒了！我今天就开始去跑步，练练体力。
text.pinyin: Tài bàng le! Wǒ jīntiān jiù kāishǐ qù pǎobù, liàn liàn tǐlì.
text.english: Fantastic! Starting today I'll go running to build up my stamina.

text.traditional: 張文華在老闆的眼中，是個認真又有能力的好員工，所以進公司不久就當上了經理。他不僅要管理各部門的員工，還得負責市場研究、規劃新產品的設計等，經常因為加班而犧牲週末的休息時間；手機裡記著每天的行程和大大小小的事情，甚至連客人的興趣都記在上面。他的生活裡好像只有工作，分分秒秒都很緊張。
text.simplified: 张文华在老板的眼中，是个认真又有能力的好员工，所以进公司不久就当上了经理。他不仅要管理各部门的员工，还得负责市场研究、规划新产品的设计等，经常因为加班而牺牲周末的休息时间；手机里记着每天的行程和大大小小的事情，甚至连客人的兴趣都记在上面。他的生活里好像只有工作，分分秒秒都很紧张。
text.pinyin: Zhāng Wénhuá zài lǎobǎn de yǎn zhōng, shì ge rènzhēn yòu yǒu nénglì de hǎo yuángōng, suǒyǐ jìn gōngsī bùjiǔ jiù dāng shàng le jīnglǐ. Tā bù jǐn yào guǎnlǐ gè bùmén de yuángōng, hái děi fùzé shìchǎng yánjiù, guīhuà xīn chǎnpǐn de shèjì děng, jīngcháng yīnwèi jiābān ér xīshēng zhōumò de xiūxí shíjiān; shǒujī lǐ jì zhe měitiān de xíngchéng hé dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng, shènzhì lián kèrén de xìngqù dōu jì zài shàngmiàn. Tā de shēnghuó lǐ hǎoxiàng zhǐyǒu gōngzuò, fēnfēn miǎomiǎo dōu hěn jǐnzhāng.
text.english: In his boss's eyes, Zhang Wenhua was a diligent and capable employee, so not long after joining the company he became manager. He not only managed employees of various departments, but also oversaw market research and planned the design of new products, often sacrificing weekend rest for overtime; his phone recorded daily schedules and matters large and small, even his clients' interests. Life seemed to consist only of work, tense every second.

text.traditional: 除了辦公室裡必要的工作，為了讓生意談得更順利，有時張文華下班以後，還得陪客人到酒吧去喝幾杯。雖然他覺得那裡的音樂聽起來像噪音，但是為了工作不能不去，有時候還會喝得太多。有一次他醉得很厲害，第二天上班時，一整天都覺得精神很差，一直到了第三天才慢慢恢復。
text.simplified: 除了办公室里必要的工作，为了让生意谈得更顺利，有时张文华下班以后，还得陪客人到酒吧去喝几杯。虽然他觉得那里的音乐听起来像噪音，但是为了工作不能不去，有时候还会喝得太多。有一次他醉得很厉害，第二天上班时，一整天都觉得精神很差，一直到了第三天才慢慢恢复。
text.pinyin: Chúle bàngōngshì lǐ bìyào de gōngzuò, wèile ràng shēngyì tán de gèng shùnlì, yǒushí Zhāng Wénhuá xiàbān yǐhòu, hái děi péi kèrén dào jiǔbā qù hē jǐ bēi. Suīrán tā juéde nàlǐ de yīnyuè tīngqǐlái xiàng zàoyīn, dànshì wèile gōngzuò bùnéngbù qù, yǒushíhòu hái huì hē de tài duō. Yǒu yí cì tā zuì de hěn lìhài, dì'èr tiān shàngbān shí, yì zhěng tiān dōu juéde jīngshén hěn chà, yìzhí dào le dì sān tiān cái mànmàn huīfù.
text.english: Besides essential office tasks, to make business negotiations run smoothly, Zhang Wenhua sometimes had to accompany clients to bars for drinks after work. Although he felt the music there sounded like noise, he had to go for work, and sometimes drank too much. Once he got very drunk, felt terrible all day at work the next day, and only gradually recovered by the third day.

text.traditional: 有一天張文華正準備出門上班時，他看到電視上播著新聞，有位明星因為工作太累、太緊張，以吸毒來忘掉痛苦，結果被警察抓了。看到這樣的新聞，他突然明白不能因為工作，而傷害自己的身心健康，所以決定重新規劃自己的生活。
text.simplified: 有一天张文华正准备出门上班时，他看到电视上播着新闻，有位明星因为工作太累、太紧张，以吸毒来忘掉痛苦，结果被警察抓了。看到这样的新闻，他突然明白不能因为工作，而伤害自己的身心健康，所以决定重新规划自己的生活。
text.pinyin: Yǒu yì tiān Zhāng Wénhuá zhèng zhǔnbèi chūmén shàngbān shí, tā kàndào diànshì shàng bō zhe xīnwén, yǒu wèi míngxīng yīnwèi gōngzuò tài lèi, tài jǐnzhāng, yǐ xīdú lái wàngdiào tòngkǔ, jiéguǒ bèi jǐngchá zhuā le. Kàndào zhèyàng de xīnwén, tā túrán míngbái bùnéng yīnwèi gōngzuò, ér shānghài zìjǐ de shēnxīn jiànkāng, suǒyǐ juédìng chóngxīn guīhuà zìjǐ de shēnghuó.
text.english: One day as Zhang Wenhua was just preparing to leave for work, he saw news on TV: a celebrity, overwhelmed and stressed from work, took drugs to forget the pain and was arrested by police. Seeing this news, he suddenly realized one must not harm mental and physical health for work, so he decided to replan his life.

text.traditional: 從那天起，他試著把年輕時的興趣找回來，開始玩音響、參加樂團。一放假就帶著孩子去海邊釣魚、去山上摘水果，也開始在院子裡種起花來了。當開花的季節到了，家人就會在院子裡看看花、聊聊天。上個星期他的樂團辦了一場戶外演唱會，好多人都去看他們的表演，結束時還放了煙火，熱鬧得不得了。
text.simplified: 从那天起，他试着把年轻时的兴趣找回来，开始玩音响、参加乐团。一放假就带着孩子去海边钓鱼、去山上摘水果，也开始在院子里种起花来了。当开花的季节到了，家人就会在院子里看看花、聊聊天。上个星期他的乐团办了一场户外演唱会，好多人都去看他们的表演，结束时还放了烟火，热闹得不得了。
text.pinyin: Cóng nà tiān qǐ, tā shìzhe bǎ niánqīng shí de xìngqù zhǎo huí lái, kāishǐ wán yīnxiǎng, cānjiā yuètuán. Yí fàngjià jiù dài zhe háizi qù hǎibiān diàoyú, qù shān shàng zhāi shuǐguǒ, yě kāishǐ zài yuànzi lǐ zhòng qǐ huā lái le. Dāng kāihuā de jìjié dào le, jiārén jiù huì zài yuànzi lǐ kànkan huā, liáo liáotiān. Shàng ge xīngqí tā de yuètuán bàn le yì chǎng hùwài yǎnchànghuì, hǎo duō rén dōu qù kàn tāmen de biǎoyǎn, jiéshù shí hái fàng le yānhuǒ, rènao de bùdéliǎo.
text.english: From that day on, he tried to recover hobbies from his youth, taking up audio gear and joining a band. On holidays he took his children fishing by the sea and fruit-picking on the mountain, and started planting flowers in the yard. When blooming season arrived, the family would enjoy the flowers and chat in the yard. Last week his band held an outdoor concert, crowds came to watch, and fireworks went off at the finale—it was lively beyond words.

text.traditional: 過去張文華滿腦子都是工作，現在下班時間快到時，就趕快把必要的工作完成，馬上離開辦公室。對他來說，生活的意義不再只是工作，「休息是為了走更遠的路」，努力往前走時，也要停下來看看周圍美麗的風景。
text.simplified: 过去张文华满脑子都是工作，现在下班时间快到时，就赶快把必要的工作完成，马上离开办公室。对他来说，生活的意义不再只是工作，「休息是为了走更远的路」，努力往前走时，也要停下来看看周围美丽的风景。
text.pinyin: Guòqù Zhāng Wénhuá mǎn nǎozi dōu shì gōngzuò, xiànzài xiàbān shíjiān kuài dào shí, jiù gǎnkuài bǎ bìyào de gōngzuò wánchéng, mǎshàng líkāi bàngōngshì. Duì tā lái shuō, shēnghuó de yìyì bú zài zhǐshì gōngzuò, “xiūxí shì wèile zǒu gèng yuǎn de lù”, nǔlì wǎng qián zǒu shí, yě yào tíng xiàlái kànkan zhōuwéi měilì de fēngjǐng.
text.english: In the past Zhang Wenhua's head was full of work; now when off-work time nears, he quickly finishes essential tasks and leaves the office immediately. To him, life's meaning is no longer just work: 'rest is for walking a longer road'; while striving forward, one must also pause to take in the beautiful scenery around.

text.traditional: 暑假快到了，你有什麼打算？最近我和幾個朋友計畫去環島旅行，想跟我們去嗎？
text.simplified: 暑假快到了，你有什么打算？最近我和几个朋友计划去环岛旅行，想跟我们去吗？
text.pinyin: Shǔjià kuài dào le, nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuàn? Zuìjìn wǒ hé jǐ ge péngyǒu jìhuà qù huándǎo lǚxíng, xiǎng gēn wǒmen qù ma?
text.english: Summer vacation is almost here. What are your plans? Recently a few friends and I are planning a trip around the island; want to come with us?

text.traditional: 想倒是想，可是我要趁暑假多打一點兒工，多存一些錢。因為畢業後，我打算去法國留學。
text.simplified: 想倒是想，可是我要趁暑假多打一点儿工，多存一些钱。因为毕业后，我打算去法国留学。
text.pinyin: Xiǎng dàoshì xiǎng, kěshì wǒ yào chèn shǔjià duō dǎ yìdiǎnr gōng, duō cún yìxiē qián. Yīnwèi bìyè hòu, wǒ dǎsuàn qù Fǎguó liúxué.
text.english: I do want to, but I need to take advantage of summer break to work a bit more and save more money. Because after graduation, I plan to study abroad in France.

text.traditional: 你平常下課後就去補習，暑假還要打工，有休閒活動的時間嗎？
text.simplified: 你平常下课后就去补习，暑假还要打工，有休闲活动的时间吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ píngcháng xiàkè hòu jiù qù bǔxí, shǔjià háiyào dǎgōng, yǒu xiūxián huódòng de shíjiān ma?
text.english: You usually go to tutoring after class, and you have to work part-time in the summer; do you have time for leisure activities?

text.traditional: 我有空的時候還是會上網看看電影、玩玩遊戲什麼的。
text.simplified: 我有空的时候还是会上网看看电影、玩玩游戏什么的。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǒukòng de shíhòu háishì huì shàngwǎng kànkan diànyǐng, wán wán yóuxì shénme de.
text.english: When I'm free, I still go online to watch movies, play games, and stuff.

text.traditional: 你不想去戶外走走嗎？最近有人調查臺灣青少年的休閒活動，發現其中有五分之四的人最常去的休閒場所是「家裡」。最讓我驚訝的是，這五分之四裡面有一半的人，週末都在家上網或睡覺。
text.simplified: 你不想去户外走走吗？最近有人调查台湾青少年的休闲活动，发现其中有五分之四的人最常去的休闲场所是「家里」。最让我惊讶的是，这五分之四里面有一半的人，周末都在家上网或睡觉。
text.pinyin: Nǐ bù xiǎng qù hùwài zǒuzǒu ma? Zuìjìn yǒurén diàochá Táiwān qīngshàonián de xiūxián huódòng, fāxiàn qízhōng yǒu wǔ fēn zhī sì de rén zuì cháng qù de xiūxián chǎngsuǒ shì “jiālǐ”. Zuì ràng wǒ jīngyà de shì, zhè wǔ fēn zhī sì lǐmiàn yǒu yíbàn de rén, zhōumò dōu zài jiā shàngwǎng huò shuìjiào.
text.english: Don't you want to go outdoors? Recently someone surveyed leisure activities of Taiwanese youth and found that for 4/5 of them, the most frequented leisure venue is 'home'. What surprised me most is that half of that 4/5 spend weekends online or sleeping at home.

text.traditional: 哈哈哈！我就是其中一個。其實，我不但喜歡戶外活動，以前還常跟哥哥去日本滑雪，做一些刺激的活動。我知道運動對身心健康很有幫助，只是最近又打工又補習，回到家就累得不想動了。
text.simplified: 哈哈哈！我就是其中一个。其实，我不但喜欢户外活动，以前还常跟哥哥去日本滑雪，做一些刺激的活动。我知道运动对身心健康很有帮助，只是最近又打工又补习，回到家就累得不想动了。
text.pinyin: Hāhāhā! Wǒ jiùshì qízhōng yíge. Qíshí, wǒ búdàn xǐhuān hùwài huódòng, yǐqián hái cháng gēn gēge qù Rìběn huáxuě, zuò yìxiē cìjī de huódòng. Wǒ zhīdào yùndòng duì shēnxīn jiànkāng hěn yǒu bāngzhù, zhǐshì zuìjìn yòu dǎgōng yòu bǔxí, huí dào jiā jiù lèi de bù xiǎng dòng le.
text.english: Hahaha! I'm one of them. Actually, not only do I like outdoor activities, I used to often go skiing in Japan with my older brother and do thrilling activities. I know exercise helps physical and mental health; it's just that lately with both part-time work and tutoring, I'm too tired to move once I get home.

text.traditional: 這樣你的體力會越來越差的，應該多出去流流汗才好。下個週末有一場海灘球賽，我們還少一位球員。你有興趣嘗試嗎？
text.simplified: 这样你的体力会越来越差的，应该多出去流流汗才好。下个周末有一场海滩球赛，我们还少一位球员。你有兴趣尝试吗？
text.pinyin: Zhèyàng nǐ de tǐlì huì yuè lái yuè chà de, yīnggāi duō chūqù liú liúhàn cái hǎo. Xià ge zhōumò yǒu yì chǎng hǎitān qiúsài, wǒmen hái shǎo yí wèi qiúyuán. Nǐ yǒu xìngqù chángshì ma?
text.english: Your physical stamina will get worse and worse this way; it's better to get out and sweat. Next weekend there is a beach ball game, and we're short one player. Interested in trying?

text.traditional: 我不去！我怕水，對大海也有心理障礙。
text.simplified: 我不去！我怕水，对大海也有心理障碍。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bú qù! Wǒ pà shuǐ, duì dàhǎi yě yǒu xīnlǐ zhàng'ài.
text.english: I'm not going! I'm afraid of water and I also have a psychological barrier toward the sea.

text.traditional: 你不想克服這個障礙嗎？
text.simplified: 你不想克服这个障碍吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ bù xiǎng kèfú zhège zhàng'ài ma?
text.english: Don't you want to overcome this barrier?

text.traditional: 當然想。上個星期我跟一位會衝浪的朋友見面，看他自由自在衝浪的樣子，好酷喔！真希望這輩子也能學會衝浪。
text.simplified: 当然想。上个星期我跟一位会冲浪的朋友见面，看他自由自在冲浪的样子，好酷喔！真希望这辈子也能学会冲浪。
text.pinyin: Dāngrán xiǎng. Shàng ge xīngqí wǒ gēn yí wèi huì chōnglàng de péngyǒu jiànmiàn, kàn tā zìyóuzìzài chōnglàng de yàngzi, hǎo kù o! Zhēn xīwàng zhè bèizi yě néng xuéhuì chōnglàng.
text.english: Of course I do. Last week I met a friend who surfs; watching him surf freely and easily was so cool! I really hope I can learn to surf in this lifetime.

text.traditional: 這樣好了，等你去了法國，我請我叔叔教你。他是個衝浪教練，我從小就跟著他學。記得有一次練習時，牙齒被衝浪板打到了，流了很多血，有一段時間不敢衝浪。還好，最後總算克服了。
text.simplified: 这样好了，等你去了法国，我请我叔叔教你。他是个冲浪教练，我从小就跟着他学。记得有一次练习时，牙齿被冲浪板打到了，流了很多血，有一段时间不敢冲浪。还好，最后总算克服了。
text.pinyin: Zhèyàng hǎo le, děng nǐ qù le Fǎguó, wǒ qǐng wǒ shúshu jiāo nǐ. Tā shì ge chōnglàng jiàoliàn, wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù gēnzhe tā xué. Jìde yǒu yí cì liànxí shí, yáchǐ bèi chōnglàngbǎn dǎ dào le, liú le hěn duō xiě, yǒu yí duàn shíjiān bù gǎn chōnglàng. Háihǎo, zuìhòu zǒngsuàn kèfú le.
text.english: How about this: once you go to France, I'll ask my uncle to teach you. He's a surf coach; I've learned from him since I was little. I remember once during practice the surfboard hit my teeth and I bled a lot, and for a while I didn't dare to surf. Fortunately, I finally overcame it.

text.traditional: 既然你這樣說，下個週末我就跟你去參加海灘球賽吧。
text.simplified: 既然你这样说，下个周末我就跟你去参加海滩球赛吧。
text.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ zhèyàng shuō, xià ge zhōumò wǒ jiù gēn nǐ qù cānjiā hǎitān qiúsài ba.
text.english: Since you put it that way, next weekend I'll go with you to join the beach ball game.

text.traditional: 太好了。不過，參加球賽是需要體力的，你最好主動一點兒，每天去慢跑。要是比賽贏了，我就招待你去吃大餐。
text.simplified: 太好了。不过，参加球赛是需要体力的，你最好主动一点儿，每天去慢跑。要是比赛赢了，我就招待你去吃大餐。
text.pinyin: Tài hǎo le. Búguò, cānjiā qiúsài shì xūyào tǐlì de, nǐ zuìhǎo zhǔdòng yìdiǎnr, měitiān qù mànpǎo. Yàoshì bǐsài yíng le, wǒ jiù zhāodài nǐ qù chī dà cān.
text.english: Awesome. However, playing in the game takes stamina; you'd better be proactive and jog every day. If we win the game, I'll treat you to a feast.

text.traditional: 太棒了！我今天就開始去跑步，練練體力。
text.simplified: 太棒了！我今天就开始去跑步，练练体力。
text.pinyin: Tài bàng le! Wǒ jīntiān jiù kāishǐ qù pǎobù, liàn liàn tǐlì.
text.english: Fantastic! Starting today I'll go running to build up my stamina.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Concede a point with 倒是/是, then turn to the contrast with 可是/但是/不過.
grammarPages.explanation: 「倒是」是副詞，前句「……倒是/是……」表示說話的人認同對方的看法、意見，語氣比較客氣。後句「可是/但是/不過……」進一步表達不同的看法。「倒是」的「倒」可以省略。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 倒是 is an adverb. The first sentence means that the speaker agrees with the other person's views and opinions, and the tone is more polite. 可是/但是/不過 then expresses different opinions. 倒 of 倒是 can be omitted.
grammarPages.pattern: X + 倒是/是 + X (the same word again)，可是/但是/不過 + a different view

patternRows.english: I do want to, but I want to do more part-time work.
Business is good, but it uses up 109,000 straws.
She is quite gentle, but she is fierce when angry.

text.traditional:
尚恩：……想跟我們去嗎？
明哲：想倒是想，可是我要趁暑假多打一點兒工，多存一些錢。
text.simplified:
尚恩：……想跟我们去吗？
明哲：想倒是想，可是我要趁暑假多打一点儿工，多存一些钱。
text.pinyin:
Shàng'ēn:… Xiǎng gēn wǒmen qù ma?
Míngzhé: Xiǎng dàoshì xiǎng, kěshì wǒ yào chèn shǔjià duō dǎ yìdiǎnr gōng, duō cún yìxiē qián.
text.english:
Shawn: …do you want to come with us?
Mingzhe: I do want to, but I want to use the summer break to do more part-time work and save up some more money.

text.traditional:
A：那家飲料店一天可以賣出三百杯珍珠奶茶，生意真好！
B：生意好是好，不過一家店一年就要用掉十萬九千根吸管（xīguǎn, straw），這樣對地球好嗎？
text.simplified:
A：那家饮料店一天可以卖出三百杯珍珠奶茶，生意真好！
B：生意好是好，不过一家店一年就要用掉十万九千根吸管（xīguǎn, straw），这样对地球好吗？
text.pinyin:
A: Nà jiā yǐnliào diàn yì tiān kěyǐ mài chū sānbǎi bēi zhēnzhū nǎichá, shēngyì zhēn hǎo!
B: Shēngyì hǎo shì hǎo, búguò yì jiā diàn yì nián jiù yào yòng diào shíwànjiǔqiān gēn xīguǎn (xīguǎn, straw), zhèyàng duì dìqiú hǎo ma?
text.english:
A: That drink shop sells 300 cups of pearl milk tea a day; business is great!
B: Business is good, but one shop uses up 109,000 straws a year. Is that good for the earth?

text.traditional:
A：聽說你媽媽的個性很溫柔。
B：溫柔倒是挺溫柔的，但是生起氣來就很兇。
text.simplified:
A：听说你妈妈的个性很温柔。
B：温柔倒是挺温柔的，但是生起气来就很凶。
text.pinyin:
A: Tīngshuō nǐ māma de gèxìng hěn wēnróu.
B: Wēnróu dàoshì tǐng wēnróu de, dànshì shēng qǐ qì lái jiù hěn xiōng.
text.english:
A: I hear your mom has a gentle personality.
B: She is quite gentle, but she is fierce when she gets angry.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Fractions: X 分之 Y (Y out of X)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say fractions and percentages with X分之Y, naming the whole (X) before the part (Y).
grammarPages.explanation: X 代表整體，Y 代表部分，說明某事物的數量在整體中的比例。例如：「2/3」的中文是「三分之二」、「5%」的中文是「百分之五」。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: X stands for the whole, and Y stands for the part, indicating the proportion of the number of things in the whole. For example, 2/3 is 三分之二, 5% is 百分之五.
grammarPages.pattern: X分之Y: 分之 sits between the whole (X) and the part (Y)

patternRows.english: Four out of five people.
Ninety out of one hundred people.
Two-thirds of the time.

text.traditional: 最近有人調查……發現其中有五分之四的人最常去的休閒場所是「家裡」。
text.simplified: 最近有人调查……发现其中有五分之四的人最常去的休闲场所是「家里」。
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn yǒu rén diàochá… fāxiàn qízhōng yǒu wǔ fēn zhī sì de rén zuì cháng qù de xiūxián chǎngsuǒ shì “jiālǐ”.
text.english: Recently someone surveyed…and found that four out of five people most often spend their leisure time at home.

text.traditional: 在這座海島上，有百分之九十的人會游泳，百分之五十的人會衝浪。
text.simplified: 在这座海岛上，有百分之九十的人会游泳，百分之五十的人会冲浪。
text.pinyin: Zài zhè zuò hǎidǎo shàng, yǒu bǎi fēn zhī jiǔshí de rén huì yóuyǒng, bǎi fēn zhī wǔshí de rén huì chōnglàng.
text.english: On this island, 90% of people can swim and 50% can surf.

text.traditional: 為了當一名成功的足球員，他每天用三分之二的時間來練體力和踢球技巧。
text.simplified: 为了当一名成功的足球员，他每天用三分之二的时间来练体力和踢球技巧。
text.pinyin: Wèile dāng yì míng chénggōng de zúqiúyuán, tā měitiān yòng sān fēn zhī èr de shíjiān lái liàn tǐlì hé tī qiú jìqiǎo.
text.english: To become a successful soccer player, he spends two-thirds of his time every day training stamina and soccer skills.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say something you hoped for has finally happened after a wait or effort, with 總算.
grammarPages.explanation: 「總算」當副詞，表示經過一段時間的等待或努力後，期待的事情實現了。常用在口語。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 總算 is an adverb, indicating that after a long time or after some hard work, something one has desired has finally been realized. Often used in spoken Chinese.
grammarPages.pattern: (Time or subject) + 總算 + hoped-for result (+ 了)

patternRows.english: In the end, I finally got over it.
Today it has finally gotten a bit warmer.
She can finally return to a carefree life.

text.traditional: ……有一段時間不敢衝浪。還好，最後總算克服了。
text.simplified: ……有一段时间不敢冲浪。还好，最后总算克服了。
text.pinyin: …Yǒu yí duàn shíjiān bù gǎn chōnglàng. Háihǎo, zuìhòu zǒngsuàn kèfú le.
text.english: …I didn't dare to surf for a while. Luckily, in the end I finally got over it.

text.traditional: 今年的冬天一連半個月溫度都在十度以下，今天總算暖和一點了。
text.simplified: 今年的冬天一连半个月温度都在十度以下，今天总算暖和一点了。
text.pinyin: Jīnnián de dōngtiān yìlián bàn ge yuè wēndù dōu zài shí dù yǐxià, jīntiān zǒngsuàn nuǎnhuo yìdiǎn le.
text.english: This winter, for half a month the temperature stayed below ten degrees; today it has finally gotten a bit warmer.

text.traditional: 王媽媽的四個孩子都長大了，她總算能回到結婚前自由自在的生活了。
text.simplified: 王妈妈的四个孩子都长大了，她总算能回到结婚前自由自在的生活了。
text.pinyin: Wáng māma de sì ge háizi dōu zhǎngdà le, tā zǒngsuàn néng huí dào jiéhūn qián zìyóuzìzài de shēnghuó le.
text.english: Mrs. Wang's four children have all grown up; she can finally return to the carefree life she had before she married.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Take a fact as given with 既然, then state your suggestion or conclusion with 就.
grammarPages.explanation: 「既然」當連詞，是前句的句首，接已經發生或確定的事實。「就」放在後句，接說話者對前面事實表示的主觀意見、建議或結論。例如：既然你不要這本書了，就給我吧。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 既然 as a conjunction is put at the beginning of the sentence. 既然 follows an event which has already occurred or facts that have already been confirmed. 就 is put in the latter part of the sentence and shows the speaker's subjective opinions, suggestions, or conclusions about the previous facts. For example, 既然你不要這本書了，就給我吧。

patternRows.english: Since you say so, I'll go with you.
Since that's the case, let's go home and rest first.
Since you feel this job holds you back, change jobs.

text.traditional:
尚恩：……最後總算克服了。
明哲：既然你這樣說，下個週末我就跟你去參加海灘球賽吧。
text.simplified:
尚恩：……最后总算克服了。
明哲：既然你这样说，下个周末我就跟你去参加海滩球赛吧。
text.pinyin:
Shàng'ēn:… Zuìhòu zǒngsuàn kèfú le.
Míngzhé: Jìrán nǐ zhèyàng shuō, xià ge zhōumò wǒ jiù gēn nǐ qù cānjiā hǎitān qiúsài ba.
text.english:
Shawn: …in the end I finally got over it.
Mingzhe: Since you put it that way, I'll go with you and play in the beach ball game next weekend.

text.traditional:
A：去逛夜市好是好，可是剛才做了那麼多刺激的活動，我現在累死了。
B：既然這樣，我們就先回家休息，晚一點再去好了。
text.simplified:
A：去逛夜市好是好，可是刚才做了那么多刺激的活动，我现在累死了。
B：既然这样，我们就先回家休息，晚一点再去好了。
text.pinyin:
A: Qù guàng yèshì hǎo shì hǎo, kěshì gāngcái zuò le nàme duō cìjī de huódòng, wǒ xiànzài lèi sǐ le.
B: Jìrán zhèyàng, wǒmen jiù xiān huí jiā xiūxí, wǎn yìdiǎn zài qù hǎo le.
text.english:
A: Going to the night market is fine, but we've just done so many thrilling things that I'm exhausted.
B: Since that's the case, let's go home and rest first, and go later.

text.traditional: 既然你覺得這份工作不能讓你發揮實力，就換個工作吧。
text.simplified: 既然你觉得这份工作不能让你发挥实力，就换个工作吧。
text.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ juéde zhè fèn gōngzuò bùnéng ràng nǐ fāhuī shílì, jiù huàn ge gōngzuò ba.
text.english: Since you feel this job doesn't let you show what you can really do, then just change jobs.

text.traditional: 張文華在老闆的眼中，是個認真又有能力的好員工，所以進公司不久就當上了經理。他不僅要管理各部門的員工，還得負責市場研究、規劃新產品的設計等，經常因為加班而犧牲週末的休息時間；手機裡記著每天的行程和大大小小的事情，甚至連客人的興趣都記在上面。他的生活裡好像只有工作，分分秒秒都很緊張。
text.simplified: 张文华在老板的眼中，是个认真又有能力的好员工，所以进公司不久就当上了经理。他不仅要管理各部门的员工，还得负责市场研究、规划新产品的设计等，经常因为加班而牺牲周末的休息时间；手机里记着每天的行程和大大小小的事情，甚至连客人的兴趣都记在上面。他的生活里好像只有工作，分分秒秒都很紧张。
text.pinyin: Zhāng Wénhuá zài lǎobǎn de yǎn zhōng, shì ge rènzhēn yòu yǒu nénglì de hǎo yuángōng, suǒyǐ jìn gōngsī bùjiǔ jiù dāng shàng le jīnglǐ. Tā bù jǐn yào guǎnlǐ gè bùmén de yuángōng, hái děi fùzé shìchǎng yánjiù, guīhuà xīn chǎnpǐn de shèjì děng, jīngcháng yīnwèi jiābān ér xīshēng zhōumò de xiūxí shíjiān; shǒujī lǐ jì zhe měitiān de xíngchéng hé dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng, shènzhì lián kèrén de xìngqù dōu jì zài shàngmiàn. Tā de shēnghuó lǐ hǎoxiàng zhǐyǒu gōngzuò, fēnfēn miǎomiǎo dōu hěn jǐnzhāng.
text.english: In his boss's eyes, Zhang Wenhua was a diligent and capable employee, so not long after joining the company he became manager. He not only managed employees of various departments, but also oversaw market research and planned the design of new products, often sacrificing weekend rest for overtime; his phone recorded daily schedules and matters large and small, even his clients' interests. Life seemed to consist only of work, tense every second.

text.traditional: 除了辦公室裡必要的工作，為了讓生意談得更順利，有時張文華下班以後，還得陪客人到酒吧去喝幾杯。雖然他覺得那裡的音樂聽起來像噪音，但是為了工作不能不去，有時候還會喝得太多。有一次他醉得很厲害，第二天上班時，一整天都覺得精神很差，一直到了第三天才慢慢恢復。
text.simplified: 除了办公室里必要的工作，为了让生意谈得更顺利，有时张文华下班以后，还得陪客人到酒吧去喝几杯。虽然他觉得那里的音乐听起来像噪音，但是为了工作不能不去，有时候还会喝得太多。有一次他醉得很厉害，第二天上班时，一整天都觉得精神很差，一直到了第三天才慢慢恢复。
text.pinyin: Chúle bàngōngshì lǐ bìyào de gōngzuò, wèile ràng shēngyì tán de gèng shùnlì, yǒushí Zhāng Wénhuá xiàbān yǐhòu, hái děi péi kèrén dào jiǔbā qù hē jǐ bēi. Suīrán tā juéde nàlǐ de yīnyuè tīngqǐlái xiàng zàoyīn, dànshì wèile gōngzuò bùnéngbù qù, yǒushíhòu hái huì hē de tài duō. Yǒu yí cì tā zuì de hěn lìhài, dì'èr tiān shàngbān shí, yì zhěng tiān dōu juéde jīngshén hěn chà, yìzhí dào le dì sān tiān cái mànmàn huīfù.
text.english: Besides essential office tasks, to make business negotiations run smoothly, Zhang Wenhua sometimes had to accompany clients to bars for drinks after work. Although he felt the music there sounded like noise, he had to go for work, and sometimes drank too much. Once he got very drunk, felt terrible all day at work the next day, and only gradually recovered by the third day.

text.traditional: 有一天張文華正準備出門上班時，他看到電視上播著新聞，有位明星因為工作太累、太緊張，以吸毒來忘掉痛苦，結果被警察抓了。看到這樣的新聞，他突然明白不能因為工作，而傷害自己的身心健康，所以決定重新規劃自己的生活。
text.simplified: 有一天张文华正准备出门上班时，他看到电视上播着新闻，有位明星因为工作太累、太紧张，以吸毒来忘掉痛苦，结果被警察抓了。看到这样的新闻，他突然明白不能因为工作，而伤害自己的身心健康，所以决定重新规划自己的生活。
text.pinyin: Yǒu yì tiān Zhāng Wénhuá zhèng zhǔnbèi chūmén shàngbān shí, tā kàndào diànshì shàng bō zhe xīnwén, yǒu wèi míngxīng yīnwèi gōngzuò tài lèi, tài jǐnzhāng, yǐ xīdú lái wàngdiào tòngkǔ, jiéguǒ bèi jǐngchá zhuā le. Kàndào zhèyàng de xīnwén, tā túrán míngbái bùnéng yīnwèi gōngzuò, ér shānghài zìjǐ de shēnxīn jiànkāng, suǒyǐ juédìng chóngxīn guīhuà zìjǐ de shēnghuó.
text.english: One day as Zhang Wenhua was just preparing to leave for work, he saw news on TV: a celebrity, overwhelmed and stressed from work, took drugs to forget the pain and was arrested by police. Seeing this news, he suddenly realized one must not harm mental and physical health for work, so he decided to replan his life.

text.traditional: 從那天起，他試著把年輕時的興趣找回來，開始玩音響、參加樂團。一放假就帶著孩子去海邊釣魚、去山上摘水果，也開始在院子裡種起花來了。當開花的季節到了，家人就會在院子裡看看花、聊聊天。上個星期他的樂團辦了一場戶外演唱會，好多人都去看他們的表演，結束時還放了煙火，熱鬧得不得了。
text.simplified: 从那天起，他试着把年轻时的兴趣找回来，开始玩音响、参加乐团。一放假就带着孩子去海边钓鱼、去山上摘水果，也开始在院子里种起花来了。当开花的季节到了，家人就会在院子里看看花、聊聊天。上个星期他的乐团办了一场户外演唱会，好多人都去看他们的表演，结束时还放了烟火，热闹得不得了。
text.pinyin: Cóng nà tiān qǐ, tā shìzhe bǎ niánqīng shí de xìngqù zhǎo huí lái, kāishǐ wán yīnxiǎng, cānjiā yuètuán. Yí fàngjià jiù dài zhe háizi qù hǎibiān diàoyú, qù shān shàng zhāi shuǐguǒ, yě kāishǐ zài yuànzi lǐ zhòng qǐ huā lái le. Dāng kāihuā de jìjié dào le, jiārén jiù huì zài yuànzi lǐ kànkan huā, liáo liáotiān. Shàng ge xīngqí tā de yuètuán bàn le yì chǎng hùwài yǎnchànghuì, hǎo duō rén dōu qù kàn tāmen de biǎoyǎn, jiéshù shí hái fàng le yānhuǒ, rènao de bùdéliǎo.
text.english: From that day on, he tried to recover hobbies from his youth, taking up audio gear and joining a band. On holidays he took his children fishing by the sea and fruit-picking on the mountain, and started planting flowers in the yard. When blooming season arrived, the family would enjoy the flowers and chat in the yard. Last week his band held an outdoor concert, crowds came to watch, and fireworks went off at the finale—it was lively beyond words.

text.traditional: 過去張文華滿腦子都是工作，現在下班時間快到時，就趕快把必要的工作完成，馬上離開辦公室。對他來說，生活的意義不再只是工作，「休息是為了走更遠的路」，努力往前走時，也要停下來看看周圍美麗的風景。
text.simplified: 过去张文华满脑子都是工作，现在下班时间快到时，就赶快把必要的工作完成，马上离开办公室。对他来说，生活的意义不再只是工作，「休息是为了走更远的路」，努力往前走时，也要停下来看看周围美丽的风景。
text.pinyin: Guòqù Zhāng Wénhuá mǎn nǎozi dōu shì gōngzuò, xiànzài xiàbān shíjiān kuài dào shí, jiù gǎnkuài bǎ bìyào de gōngzuò wánchéng, mǎshàng líkāi bàngōngshì. Duì tā lái shuō, shēnghuó de yìyì bú zài zhǐshì gōngzuò, “xiūxí shì wèile zǒu gèng yuǎn de lù”, nǔlì wǎng qián zǒu shí, yě yào tíng xiàlái kànkan zhōuwéi měilì de fēngjǐng.
text.english: In the past Zhang Wenhua's head was full of work; now when off-work time nears, he quickly finishes essential tasks and leaves the office immediately. To him, life's meaning is no longer just work: 'rest is for walking a longer road'; while striving forward, one must also pause to take in the beautiful scenery around.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Name the situation or range you are speaking within, with 在…中.
grammarPages.explanation: 用來表示在某個情況或範圍裡，「在」的後面可以是名詞短語。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 在……中 is used to indicate being in a certain situation or area; 在 can be followed by a noun phrase.

patternRows.english: In the boss's eyes, he is a conscientious, capable employee.
In my heart, family matters most.
In the meeting, a product survey was mentioned.

text.traditional: 張文華在老闆的眼中，是個認真又有能力的好員工……
text.simplified: 张文华在老板的眼中，是个认真又有能力的好员工……
text.pinyin: Zhāng Wénhuá zài lǎobǎn de yǎn zhōng, shì ge rènzhēn yòu yǒu nénglì de hǎo yuángōng…
text.english: In his boss's eyes, Zhang Wenhua is a good employee, conscientious and capable…

text.traditional:
A：我發現你好像從不加班，為什麼？
B：我每天都要回家跟家人吃晚飯，因為在我心中，家人比什麼都重要。
text.simplified:
A：我发现你好像从不加班，为什么？
B：我每天都要回家跟家人吃晚饭，因为在我心中，家人比什么都重要。
text.pinyin:
A: Wǒ fāxiàn nǐ hǎoxiàng cóngbù jiābān, wèishénme?
B: Wǒ měitiān dōu yào huí jiā gēn jiārén chī wǎnfàn, yīnwèi zài wǒ xīn zhōng, jiārén bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào.
text.english:
A: I've noticed you never seem to work overtime; why?
B: I go home every day to have dinner with my family, because in my heart family matters more than anything.

text.traditional:
A：你剛才在會議中，提到一份商品調查的資料，請問哪裡查得到？
B：就在會議報告中的第十頁，你翻一下應該就看得到。
text.simplified:
A：你刚才在会议中，提到一份商品调查的资料，请问哪里查得到？
B：就在会议报告中的第十页，你翻一下应该就看得到。
text.pinyin:
A: Nǐ gāngcái zài huìyì zhōng, tídào yí fèn shāngpǐn diàochá de zīliào, qǐngwèn nǎlǐ chá de dào?
B: Jiù zài huìyì bàogào zhōng de dì shí yè, nǐ fān yíxià yīnggāi jiù kàn de dào.
text.english:
A: You mentioned a product survey in the meeting just now; where can I find it?
B: It's on page ten of the meeting report; if you flip through, you should see it.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Must (不能不) / Have No Choice but To (不得不)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say you must do something with 不能不 (duty) or 不得不 (no choice, reluctant).
grammarPages.explanation:
(一)不能不
「不能不」有應該、必須、一定要負責某件事，不做不行的意思。
(二)不得不
表示當事人的心裡不願意做某件事，因為沒辦法只好做了，有無奈的感覺，語氣比「不能不」強。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish:
(一)不能不
不能不 means that you should, must, and definitely will be responsible for something, and you cannot not to do it.
(二)不得不
不得不 shows that the person does not want to do something. However, he has no choice but to do it, and he feels helpless. The tone is stronger than 不能不.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不能不 / 不得不 + Action

patternRows.english: Mr. Niu has to move to a bigger house.
I have to come home a bit early.
My uncle has no choice but to retire a bit early.

text.traditional: 雖然他覺得那裡的音樂聽起來像噪音，但是為了工作不能不去……
text.simplified: 虽然他觉得那里的音乐听起来像噪音，但是为了工作不能不去……
text.pinyin: Suīrán tā juéde nàlǐ de yīnyuè tīngqǐlái xiàng zàoyīn, dànshì wèile gōngzuò bùnéngbù qù…
text.english: Although he thinks the music there sounds like noise, he has to go for work…

text.traditional: 牛先生為了讓每個孩子都有自己的房間，不能不換大一點的房子。
text.simplified: 牛先生为了让每个孩子都有自己的房间，不能不换大一点的房子。
text.pinyin: Niú xiānshēng wèile ràng měi ge háizi dōu yǒu zìjǐ de fángjiān, bùnéngbù huàn dà yìdiǎn de fángzi.
text.english: So that each child can have a room of their own, Mr. Niu has to move to a bigger house.

text.traditional: 今天晚上爸媽要參加朋友的婚禮，讓我照顧弟弟妹妹，我不能不早一點回家。
text.simplified: 今天晚上爸妈要参加朋友的婚礼，让我照顾弟弟妹妹，我不能不早一点回家。
text.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshàng bàmā yào cānjiā péngyǒu de hūnlǐ, ràng wǒ zhàogù dìdi mèimei, wǒ bùnéngbù zǎo yìdiǎn huí jiā.
text.english: Tonight my parents are going to a friend's wedding and are having me look after my younger siblings, so I have to come home a bit early.

text.traditional: 就算百貨公司，也可能賣品質不佳的商品，所以不管在哪裡購物都不能不檢查。
text.simplified: 就算百货公司，也可能卖品质不佳的商品，所以不管在哪里购物都不能不检查。
text.pinyin: Jiùsuàn bǎihuò gōngsī, yě kěnéng mài pǐnzhí bù jiā de shāngpǐn, suǒyǐ bùguǎn zài nǎlǐ gòuwù dōu bùnéngbù jiǎnchá.
text.english: Even department stores may sell poor-quality goods, so no matter where you shop, you have to check what you buy.

text.traditional: 我叔叔才五十歲，最近因為生病的關係，不得不早一點退休。
text.simplified: 我叔叔才五十岁，最近因为生病的关系，不得不早一点退休。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shúshu cái wǔshí suì, zuìjìn yīnwèi shēngbìng de guānxì, bùdébù zǎo yìdiǎn tuìxiū.
text.english: My uncle is only fifty; recently, because of illness, he has no choice but to retire a bit early.

text.traditional: 這個地區發生了嚴重的森林火災，許多人的房子被燒掉了，不得不離開，到安全的地方去。
text.simplified: 这个地区发生了严重的森林火灾，许多人的房子被烧掉了，不得不离开，到安全的地方去。
text.pinyin: Zhège dìqū fāshēng le yánzhòng de sēnlín huǒzāi, xǔduō rén de fángzi bèi shāo diào le, bùdébù líkāi, dào ānquán de dìfāng qù.
text.english: A serious forest fire broke out in this area. Many people's houses burned down, and they had no choice but to leave and go somewhere safe.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say one thing was just starting when another happened by coincidence, with 正 + V.
grammarPages.explanation: 「正」當副詞，有剛好、巧合的意思。「正」後面的第一件事剛開始做或剛好準備要做時，第二件事也很巧合的發生了，例如：「我正打開門時，就看見爸爸回來了」、「我正要回家，就下起雨來了」。「正」後面常接「要、想、打算、準備」等動詞。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 正 is an adverb, followed by a verb or an auxillary verb, which means "coincidentally". The first thing after 正 has just started or has already been completed, and the second thing happens by coincidence. For example, 我正打開門時，就看見爸爸回來了。Or 我正要回家，就下起雨來了。正 is often followed by verbs such as 要, 想, 打算, 準備, etc.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 正 + (要/想/打算/準備) + action (+ 時)，(就) + second event

patternRows.english: I was about to call Xiao Ji when I got his call.
I was about to enter the elevator when an earthquake suddenly happened.
I was replying to a friend's message when he suddenly appeared.

text.traditional: 有一天張文華正準備出門上班時，他看到電視上播著新聞……
text.simplified: 有一天张文华正准备出门上班时，他看到电视上播着新闻……
text.pinyin: Yǒu yì tiān Zhāng Wénhuá zhèng zhǔnbèi chūmén shàngbān shí, tā kàndào diànshì shàng bō zhe xīnwén…
text.english: One day, just as Zhang Wenhua was getting ready to leave for work, he saw the news playing on TV…

text.traditional: 我正想打電話給小紀時，就接到他打來的電話。
text.simplified: 我正想打电话给小纪时，就接到他打来的电话。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng xiǎng dǎ diànhuà gěi Xiǎo Jì shí, jiù jiēdào tā dǎ lái de diànhuà.
text.english: Just as I was about to call Xiao Ji, I got a call from him.

text.traditional: 我正要進電梯時，突然發生地震，還好我沒進去。
text.simplified: 我正要进电梯时，突然发生地震，还好我没进去。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng yào jìn diàntī shí, túrán fāshēng dìzhèn, háihǎo wǒ méi jìnqù.
text.english: Just as I was about to enter the elevator, an earthquake suddenly happened; luckily I didn't go in.

text.traditional: 我正用手機回朋友的信時，他突然出現在我面前，嚇了我一跳。
text.simplified: 我正用手机回朋友的信时，他突然出现在我面前，吓了我一跳。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng yòng shǒujī huí péngyǒu de xìn shí, tā túrán chūxiàn zài wǒ miànqián, xià le wǒ yí tiào.
text.english: Just as I was replying to a friend's message on my phone, he suddenly appeared in front of me and gave me a fright.
